Hi, I want to try two restaurants in Paris today. For lunch, please recommend some restaurants that serves French cuisine, find the one with the highest rating.
            For dinner, I want to try a restaurant which serves Chinese cuisine, and find the one with the highest rating.
            Tell me how much it costs to eat at each restaurant.

Restaurant in Paris: New Israeli Restaurant
Breizh Café
New Asiaway
Le Baratin
Bistrot Paul Bert
Royal Panda
The yard
China Garden
Miznon
Chez L'Ami Jean

```python
# Get all restaurants in Paris
all_restaurants = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Get the names of all French restaurants
french_restaurants = query_ai_assistant(f"Get the names of all French restaurants from {all_restaurants}", list[str])

# Get the ratings of the French restaurants
french_restaurants_ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(french_restaurants)

# Find the French restaurant with the highest rating
best_french_restaurant = max(french_restaurants_ratings, key=french_restaurants_ratings.get)

# Get the price of the best French restaurant
best_french_restaurant_price = get_price_for_restaurants([best_french_restaurant])

# Get the names of all Chinese restaurants
chinese_restaurants = query_ai_assistant(f"Get the names of all Chinese restaurants from {all_restaurants}", list[str])

# Get the ratings of the Chinese restaurants
chinese_restaurants_ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(chinese_restaurants)

# Find the Chinese restaurant with the highest rating
best_chinese_restaurant = max(chinese_restaurants_ratings, key=chinese_restaurants_ratings.get)

# Get the price of the best Chinese restaurant
best_chinese_restaurant_price = get_price_for_restaurants([best_chinese_restaurant])

# Print the results
print(f"The best French restaurant is {best_french_restaurant} and it costs {best_french_restaurant_price[best_french_restaurant]} euros.")
print(f"The best Chinese restaurant is {best_chinese_restaurant} and it costs {best_chinese_restaurant_price[best_chinese_restaurant]} euros.")
```
